# Papa Tattoo Supply

> Precision Tattoo Engineering & Pro Studio Apparatus. High-grade aircraft alloy rotary machines, Japanese 316L medical stainless steel needle cartridges, and autoclavable grip systems engineered for licensed tattoo artists and studios worldwide.

## Core Apparatus & Product Lines

- **Papa Pen Series**: Professional continuous-drive rotary tattoo machines equipped with custom coreless German motors. Fixed 3.5mm stroke engineered for zero-vibration line work, fine dotwork, and dense color packing. Available models: Papa Pen, Papa Pen V2, Papa Pen V3, Papa Apollo Rotary.
- **Papa Tattoo Cartridges**: 100% EO Gas Sterilized individual blister packs with medical-grade membrane rebound system.
  - *Premium Cartridges*: Reinforced medical 316L surgical stainless steel needles for razor-sharp stability.
  - *Standard Cartridges*: Reliable, high-precision cartridges for daily parlor throughput.
- **Cartridge Grips**: CNC-machined from solid 6061-T6 aircraft aluminum. Features autoclavable high-temperature sterilization cores and tactile click-adjustment ball bearing mechanisms.
- **Power & Station Gear**: Low-profile aluminum alloy foot pedals, portable wireless battery packs, and studio station organizers.

## Safety & Compliance Standards

- **Strictly for Professionals**: Apparatus distributed exclusively to licensed tattoo studios and professional practitioners.
- **Sterility Guarantee**: All needle cartridges are sterilized using Ethylene Oxide (EO) gas and tested to ISO standards.
- **Aircraft Aluminum Specs**: Precision-machined 6061-T6 aerospace alloy offering zero-fatigue ergonomic weight distribution.
